known_blockers.name: R8 code read (input generator lets random pointers reach code; fix the generator, not R8)

blocker_kinds.fix: infrastructure: re-run the preparation alone on an idle machine with a longer ghidra_timeout_s; if it still times out, read the slot log for the hanging script
checker (batch 7, fpu_state): the whole FPU (fr0..15, XMTRX, FPSCR.FR/SZ/PR) is state for mode-switching functions; re-prepare these
checker (batch 7, fpu_state): XMTRX is compared at exit and at every call (sh4_frchg, sh4_fschg, sh4_ftrv_fv); re-prepare these
checker: parameter storage r0..r3 and fr4..fr11 read before written (signature inputs from dataflow)
checker: any return register, and a u64 return in r0:r1, in the harness and runtime
packet: asm-only packet with a signature from dataflow; Haiku translates from the asm
checker: cross-module calls (an overlay jumping into another overlay or the main binary)

blocker_kinds.detail: ^oracle could not produce .*(write outside RAM|fault: read)
blocker_kinds.fix: oracle: seed pointer-like parameters (and pointers loaded through them) into a scratch RAM window
oracle: model PR-redirected tail calls (lds rN,PR then bra: the callee returns to the loaded PR); check for data seeded as code
oracle: model FPSCR.DN denormal flush instead of rejecting the run
oracle: an input-dependent loop the random inputs never end, or data seeded as code; read the function first
oracle/SLEIGH: an instruction the emulator cannot decode; usually data seeded as code (prune it)
oracle: keep pointer inputs out of the code range in the input generator; do not loosen R8
oracle: random pointers reach unmapped memory on the C side; seed pointers into RAM (same fix as oracle_bad_pointers)

blocker_kinds.diff: ^(fr1[2-5] \(vector register, sh4_fr\(\d+\)\) at exit|call #\d+ to 0x[0-9a-f]+: argument fr\d+ )
blocker_kinds.fix: checker: TcPrepare adds fr4..fr11 read before written as parameters (entry float registers the C cannot see)
retry: more dev vectors (e.g. 96) so the edge case shows in dev; the hidden check is unchanged

blocker_kinds.diff: ^(no result for this vector|C code raised exception)
blocker_kinds.fix: retry: the C crashes or loops on some vectors; one more Haiku run from its best work.c
retry: a real translation mistake (memory, return value, call target or argument); one more Haiku run from its best work.c
retry: the last attempt does not build or breaks a rule; one more Haiku run from its best work.c
